effectiveGoalTool.name: hollywood_goal_create
effectiveGoalTool.description: Record a finite accountable Goal from this current accepted human/agent request or original native standing-role work. The canonical Role persists separately; Goal creation is not a chat self-request or a new human assignment. Optional roomId selects its collaboration room independently of agent context. For another room explicitly set publishScopedIntent=true: only selected Goal intent is published there, never private source text. Original source must be room-visible. reviewBudget bounds authorized material reviews; creation assigns no work.
